app.name: Virasat
app.tagline: Family recipes, in the voices of the people who made them.

landing.headline: Keep the recipes that live in their hands
landing.body: Record Ba telling her recipe in her own words. Keep her voice, her handwriting and her stories, and pass them down.

signIn.title: Sign in or create an account
signIn.subtitle: We'll send you a code. There's no password to remember.
signIn.phoneHint: Include your country code, like +91 or +44.
signIn.checkEmailBody: We sent a sign-in link and a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Tap the link, or enter the code here.
signIn.startOver: Use a different email or number
signIn.privacy: Your family's recipes stay private unless you choose to share them.
signIn.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new code.
signIn.codeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
signIn.sendFailed: We couldn't send a code. Check the details and try again.
signIn.smsFailed: We couldn't send a text to that number. Check it, or sign in with email instead.
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

onboarding.title: Name your family vault
onboarding.body: This is where your family's recipes, voices and stories will live. Most families use their surname.

vault.peopleEmptyTitle: Add the people whose recipes you want to keep
vault.peopleEmptyBody: Start with someone who cooks from memory. They don't need an account.

roles.ownerHelp: Can do everything, including managing owners.
roles.adminHelp: Can invite family and manage people.
roles.memberHelp: Can add and edit people and recipes.
roles.viewerHelp: Can look, but can't change anything.

person.nameHint: Their full name, as you'd write it.
person.relationHint: Like Ba, Nani, Masi or Oma.
person.notesHint: Where they learned to cook, what they're known for.
person.photoTooLarge: That photo is too large. Choose one under 10 MB.
person.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this vault? Their details will be hidden from everyone.

members.title: Family members
members.leaveConfirm: Leave {{vault}}? You'll lose access until someone invites you again.
members.lastOwner: A vault needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

invite.title: Invite family
invite.channelLinkHelp: Send it on WhatsApp, by message or any way you like.
invite.channelPhoneHelp: Only someone signing in with this number can use it.
invite.channelEmailHelp: Only someone signing in with this email can use it.
invite.forPerson: Are they already in this vault?
invite.forPersonHelp: Link them to someone you've already added, so their recipes connect to them.
invite.readyBody: Send this link. It works once and expires on {{date}}.
invite.whatsappText: Join our family recipe vault on Virasat: {{url}}

join.title: {{inviter}} invited you to {{vault}}
join.body: Join to see and add your family's recipes. You'll join as: {{role}}.
join.invalidBody: It may have expired, been cancelled or already been used. Ask for a new one.
join.wrongAccount: This invite was sent to a different phone number or email. Sign in with that one, or ask for a new invite.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unitsHelp: How suggested quantities are shown. Your family's own words always stay exactly as they said them.

errors.country: Choose a country from the list.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notAllowed: You don't have permission to do that.

consent.title: Before you record
consent.elderFamily: This recording is for your family. Only people in your family's vault can listen to it.
consent.elderComputer: A computer listens to it and writes your recipe down. The companies that do this don't keep your voice or use it for anything else.
consent.elderKeep: Your voice is kept safely in India. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time.
consent.organiserCheckbox: {{name}} knows this recording is for the family, and agrees to it being recorded, written down and kept.
consent.organiserNote: If {{name}} changes their mind, you can delete the recording at any time.
consent.scanNote: A computer reads this page to type up the recipe. The original photo stays in your family vault.
consent.limitReached: That's 10 minutes, the most one recording can hold. Everything you said has been kept.
